limits: CT windowed grayscale threshold is not a brain segmentation.
No Dice/IoU is reported as anatomical accuracy.
Nuclei, tracts and small nerves cannot be established from these CT overlays.
MRI and CT are different subjects; correspondence must use homologous macro landmarks.
Overlay inspection is not clinical validation or population morphometry.
